svg.title: Where the cache stops
svg.desc: Three copies of the same request: tool definitions, system prompt, instruction files, conversation and new message. In the first, everything except the new message comes from cache. In the second, a change after the tool definitions makes everything after it recomputed, although that text is unchanged. In the third, a different model cannot use any of the first model's cache.

g.text: Only the new part is processed
Something early in the request changed
Everything after the change is recomputed, even unchanged text
Each model has its own cache: only a start it cached itself can be read
What is cached: the model's working state for the start of the request (its keys and values),
not your text. A stored answer is never returned; each reply is generated fresh.
